lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? A riddle: why does water—wait, a moth. Five more minutes? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What's up? A riddle: why does water—wait, a moth. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: At The Cracked Fountain, a tiny firecracker pops beside your boot. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at it proves administratively impossible.

lines.native: ¡Mira! That's looking, not stopping! Sí, sigo aquí. Riddle: how will you make me stop—wait, another moth. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Look! That's looking, not stopping! Yes, I'm still here. Riddle: how will you make me stop—wait, another moth. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks obediently at a moth and continues moving. A tiny firecracker files a complaint beside your shoe.

lines.native: ¡Vale, no me muevo! Your stopping power? Ten out of ten. ¿Por dónde voy? A riddle: which way—wait, moving leaf. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Okay, I’m not moving! Your stopping power? Ten out of ten. Which way do I go? A riddle: which way—wait, moving leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without it, apparently employed on a separate contract.

lines.native: ¡Eso es inglés! ¿Por dónde voy? Spanish directions, please. A riddle: which way does—ooh, smoke. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: That's English! Which way do I go? Spanish directions, please. A riddle: which way does—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. A riddle: when does—wait, moth. Just one more distraction. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! What time is it? The clock doesn't work. A riddle: when does—wait, moth. Just one more distraction. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, then vanishes into the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker draws your attention to the fountain’s stopped clock, which has made excellent progress at doing nothing.

lines.native: ¡Eso es para después! You scheduled it. ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. A riddle: when does—ooh, sparks. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: That is for later! You scheduled it. What time is it? The clock doesn't work. A riddle: when does—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick is already elsewhere, supervising nothing.

lines.native: ¡Sí, es medianoche! Muy bien. Pero tenemos tiempo. ¿Podemos esperar un poco? A riddle: why hurry when—ooh, sparks. Five more minutes? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, it's midnight! Very good. But we have time. Can we wait a little? A riddle: why hurry when—ooh, sparks. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick applauds from the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker marks midnight; the clock declines to corroborate.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, sí! Eso es esperar. Mi canción sigue. ¿Cuándo lo hacemos? ¿Tenemos tiempo? A riddle: when does—ooh, sparks. Just one more. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, yes! That's waiting. My song continues. When do we do it? Do we have time? A riddle: when does—ooh, sparks. Just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick tosses a tiny firecracker from the corner you are not watching. Your agreement has achieved another postponement. Business remains briskly undone.

lines.native: ¡Ahora! Sí, entiendo. No mañana. ¡Tú ganas! ¿Qué hago sin esperar? A riddle—oh no. ¡Mi canción no funciona! ¡Después, después, mañana! Just one more?
lines.translation: Now! Yes, I understand. Not tomorrow. You win! What do I do without waiting? A riddle—oh no. My song doesn’t work! Later, later, tomorrow! Just one more?
lines.narrative: Flick’s tiny firecracker goes unthrown. For once, the delay belongs to him.
